QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_68

question.text: An AIF has initial Set-up Cost of INR 2.5 crore (incl. GST), amortised over the fund life of 5 years. Set-up cost charged to Year 1 P&L of the fund:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Straight-line amortisation: 2.5 crore / 5 years = INR 0.50 crore per year. **The Trap:** Option B is total one-time (wrong). Option C uses wrong denominator. Option D doubles. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B for amortisation; XIX-C requires LP disclosure. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** If fund extends 1-2 years beyond original tenure, disclose upfront how set-up cost amortisation extends — some LPs expect pro-rata reduction in post-extension years, which isn't accounting standard but is commonly negotiated.
